ocr.download_location: build machine only; no app download path

checks: Four English tokenizer fixtures and normalized ONNX embedding cosine > .999 against desktop
SQLite index opening and selected-root listing
Native two-page PDF extraction and semantic preference for the relevant page
Blank and malformed PDF issue codes
SQLite migrations preserve original text passages and PDF pages
PNG OCR words, exact code, pixel regions and semantic passage preference
Canceled OCR returns no partial evidence

limits: APK manifest inspection is not a complete OS egress audit
PDF text search requires Android 15+; older OS guard and physical devices remain unexercised
No physical-phone, independent user, TalkBack, battery or mobile holdout validation
